issues: Built at 480x270 design coordinates and scaled: body 10, pills 7.5 and eyebrow 6.5 design px, so small fields were hard to read and there was no shot-scale hierarchy
A cream card on a dark backdrop with lots of empty black around it and cluttered spacing inside
Fields simply faded in one by one, with no cue that the card was being extracted or filled in
Timing used 60-denominator recipe frames with 2-frame gaps that were too dense, so the price drop did not stand out
changes: Porcelain look (cool white, cobalt), redrawn at native 1920: a 1520x840 card with a 108px title, 112px price, 34px body and 28px pills

A cobalt autofill cursor (outline box plus AUTOFILL tag) jumps to each slot 2f ahead of the field, morphing between boxes with a 6f asymmetric in-out, and finally folds into the button: the only light effect
Before landing, each slot holds a light-grey skeleton bar that fades as the content rises, so the form reads as being filled in cell by cell
The price beat is bigger: $449 lands and holds 18f, then shrinks, greys and gets struck through in one 6f window, cobalt $349 springs from 1.18 to 1 and SAVE 22% slides in
The product shot is a vector over-ear headphone 'Aero Max' with a contact shadow; the end adds an ink button that fills left to right
150f to 172f, retimed in 30fps frames: 3f inside a group, 10-20f between groups, 40f hold at the end
